summary: Backend-only test of bodega deletion orphan fix and force-delete product collection fix. All 4 scenarios PASSED (100%). Confirmed: (1) non-superadmin gets 403; (2) QA-BOD-REAL blocked with 400 and exact message 'No se puede eliminar una bodega con existencias'; (3) QA-BOD-ORPHAN with only orphan existencia now deletes with 200 'Bodega eliminada' and is removed from listing; (4) force-delete of QA-PROD-REAL cleans existencia in correct collection ('existencias_inventario'), allowing subsequent deletion of QA-BOD-REAL with 200.
seed_data_creation: None created; used pre-seeded QA-BOD-ORPHAN, QA-BOD-REAL, QA-PROD-REAL. All were consumed by tests (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed data QA-BOD-ORPHAN, QA-BOD-REAL, QA-PROD-REAL was consumed (deleted) during this run. If re-testing this fix, main agent must re-seed the QA data first. Exact HTTP responses captured: 403 'Solo SuperAdmin puede eliminar bodegas', 400 'No se puede eliminar una bodega con existencias', 200 'Bodega eliminada', force-delete producto returns 'Producto eliminado' with movimientos_eliminados counter.
rca of the issue: Fix verified: eliminar_bodega now ignores orphan existencias (those referencing deleted products) and cleans them up before delete; eliminar_producto force-mode now targets the correct 'existencias_inventario' collection (previously wrote to 'existencias_bodega'), preventing new orphans.
